piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS, ARORA'S BENCH BITES BACK
piece.big_picture: Haaland let down 95 armbands, the top 3's included. Rajat Arora binned 31 points on his bench and still stretched his lead over Neol. Yash Bhatia slid back in third. The title race is alive, but Arora holds the whip hand.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Yash Gawai brought in Van Hecke, Evanilson and Silva. The swap was worth 31 points and powered the week's best score. Bold, busy, correct. Eli's 3-in-3-out made 27.
piece.one_to_watch: Sukrut and Clawin are only 2 points apart on the Big prizes line. Whoever picks the better captain could grab the spot. Up top, Neol sits 16 behind Arora.

winners.name: Rahil
winners.verdict: Went for N.Jackson as captain and got 18 points from the armband. Nerve paid off. Rahil climbed 16 places.

winners.name: Akshat
winners.verdict: Skipped Haaland, backed N.Jackson, and the armband returned 18. The best rebel call of the week. Pure nerve, and it landed.

losers.name: Rohan
losers.verdict: Bottom of the pile on 31 points. A rotten week, and the sort that happens to everyone. Plenty of time to bounce back.

losers.name: Neil
losers.verdict: Cherki and N.Jackson arrived, the points did not. A slide to 102nd. The transfers never came off.

losers.name: Udit
losers.verdict: A big chunk of the squad did the sitting out while the team stumbled. Selection was the crime, and he has no alibi.
